ruleAction.title: Rule Action
ruleAction.description_alert: Th' rule {rule} sent an alert t' {channel}
ruleAction.description_timeout: Th' rule {rule} threw {member} in th' brig for {duration}
ruleAction.description_kick: Th' rule {rule} made {member} walk th' plank
ruleAction.description_delmsg: Th' rule {rule} scrubbed a message from {member} in {channel}
ruleAction.description_budget: Th' rule {rule} reached its hourly limit, so some o' what it does was skipped
ruleAction.description_flag_no_permission: Th' rule {rule} could not act: Quark be missin' a permission it needs
ruleAction.description_flag_hierarchy: Th' rule {rule} could not act on {member}: they be th' ship's cap'n, or thar highest rank be not below Quark's
ruleAction.description_flag: Th' rule {rule} could not do what it says
ruleAction.description_flag_error: Th' rule {rule} could not be checked, an' was skipped
ruleAction.description_role_give: Th' rule {rule} promoted {member} t' th' {role} rank
ruleAction.description_role_take: Th' rule {rule} demoted {member} from th' {role} rank
ruleAction.description_dm: Th' rule {rule} sent {member} a direct message
ruleAction.description_flag_role: Th' rule {rule} could not give or take {role}: th' rank be gone, be managed by an integration, or be not below Quark's highest rank
ruleAction.dm_footer: Sent automatically by a rule aboard {server}
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_permission: Th' rule {rule} could not act: th' sailor who last changed it no longer has th' Discord permission it needs, or has left th' ship. It will act again once somebody who has that permission edits it, or switches it off an' on
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_timeout: Th' rule {rule} could not act: th' sailor who last changed it be in th' brig, an' a crewmate in th' brig cannot moderate. It will act again when thar time in th' brig ends
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_channel: Th' rule {rule} could not scrub a message in {channel}: th' sailor who last changed th' rule cannot scrub messages there themselves
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_hierarchy: Th' rule {rule} could not act on {member}: thar highest rank be not below that o' th' sailor who last changed th' rule
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_role: Th' rule {rule} could not give or take {role}: th' rank be not below th' highest rank o' th' sailor who last changed th' rule
ruleAction.description_flag_role_elevated: Th' rule {rule} could not give {role}: th' rank comes with moderation or management permissions, an' only a rule th' ship's cap'n last changed gives one o' those
